title: GTP Lawyers Podcast - Videos
description:
Join Matt Guichard of GTP Lawyers as he presents a series of interviews covering general community events and his Podcast, No Holds Barred, where he recounts stories of past court cases in an educational and entertaining manner. The shows will be less than 30 minutes each, so quick and fun to watch.

Matt Guichard
GTP Laywers
101 Ygnacio Valley Road, Suite 112
Walnut Creek, CA 94596
